jobs.title: Database Engineer (PostgreSQL/MSSQL)
jobs.description:
About Us

At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Win as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.

About The Role

As DBE, you will be responsible for the design, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of the organization's relational database systems. This role will ensure the integrity, availability, and performance of critical data to support business operations and decision-making processes. The DBE will work closely with IT teams, developers, and business stakeholders to deliver efficient and scalable database solutions that meet the organization's current and future needs. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills in Postgres and SQL Server database management systems hosted in AWS, excellent problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to translate business requirements into effective relational database solutions. This role will be critical in maintaining the organization's data infrastructure, enabling data-driven decision-making, and ensuring the optimal performance of mission-critical applications across the enterprise.

What will you be doing?

Develop database schemas, tables, and indexes to optimize performance and ensure data integrity.
Implement and maintain database security measures, including user authentication, access controls, and data encryption.
Analyze and interpret database performance metrics to proactively identify areas for improvement
Monitor database performance and troubleshoot issues such as slow queries, database locks, and resource contention.
Identify and address performance bottlenecks through query optimization, index tuning, and database configuration adjustments.
Optimize database indexes, query execution plans, and caching strategies to improve application responsiveness and scalability.
Write and optimize SQL queries and stored procedures to efficiently retrieve and manipulate data.
Configure and maintain database replication, clustering, or failover mechanisms to provide resilience against hardware failures, network outages, or natural disasters.
Participate in code reviews to ensure adherence to database best practices, performance guidelines, and data access patterns.
Collaborate with software developers to design database schemas that align with application requirements and development workflows.
Work closely with application developers to optimize SQL queries, data access patterns, and database interactions for maximum efficiency.
Perform regular backups and disaster recovery procedures to ensure data availability and integrity.
Stay abreast of emerging database technologies, trends, and best practices through self-study, training, and participation in industry forums and conferences.

What are we looking for?

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field In-depth knowledge and proficiency in PL\pgSQL and T-SQL
Strong understanding of database design principles, including normalization, indexing, and data modeling
Knowledge of database security best practices and experience in implementing security measures such as user authentication, access controls, encryption, and auditing are important
Knowledge of the AWS RDS solution
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
Effective communication and collaboration skills
Communicative level of English

Tech stack

PostgreSQL
MS SQL
Amazon Web Services
C# .Net

What do we offer?

🏢💻 Hybrid Framework
- The best of both worlds! Work from home when you need focus and flexibility, and spend 2 days a week in the office for face-to-face collaboration, sharing ideas and catching up with the team. Because some things are simply better together!

📙 Personal Training Budget.
Up to 7.000 year training budget (certifications, conferences attendance, etc.) to invest in your professional development. We want to help you improve your technical skills, feel involved in the product community, and develop your soft skills to lead teams and manage other stakeholders.

📺 Internal and external training, free access to online training platforms
such as Linkedin Learning

🗺️ Languages classes
every week. Thirsty for knowledge? Learn a new language by joining our free English/Spanish/German classes. You can connect and enjoy taking up a new language or improving your current skills with one of our great instructors.

💜 Lunch card.
Enjoy a subsidized lunch card and grab a meal with your teammates — because the best conversations often happen over lunch!

🏥 Free private medical insurance
. Take care of your health with private medical care fully covered by us

📄 Attractive life insurance
. Extra peace of mind for you and your loved ones.

🏐
Co-financed Multisport card - We support an active lifestyle because staying healthy and feeling good matters.

😊 Volunteer day.
You can take 16 hours per year in order to participate in volunteering activities! We will love to see some pictures in our slack!

🌅 Up to 30 days of vacation per year (
additional days are granted along with seniority at AUCTANE).

💙 Up to 1000 PLN/year PLN/year to match your NGO donations
! We are happy to support your initiatives by duplicating the amount donated.

👩‍⚕️We have an Employee Assistance Program
with psychological assistance free of charge for you and your loved ones.

🗓️ Annual Salary Review:
We are reviewing the salaries of all our teams annually in order to evaluate an increase according to individual performance and the business results.

Referral Fee
🔗 We need your support in hiring top-class talent! We offer a referral bonus of 4k-20k PLN, depending on the complexity of the role and the hiring process.

💜 An inclusive and upbeat work environment
Leave your suit behind... we’re a t-shirt and converse kind of place! More importantly, our company culture promotes diversity and inclusion. The personality and opinions of each of our team members are important and valid, and we aim to offer all employees a safe environment where they can be themselves and thrive.

🌍 A cross-cultural atmosphere
We are a truly international team of 20 nationalities that speak 10 languages. Our company language is English and all internal communication and company-wide meetings are in English.

🏟️ Company events
We do our best every day, even at our regular team-building events.

🏢 Nice Office in Zielona Gora and Wroclaw
(free drinks, snacks…)

Do you want to know a little bit more about the team? Please, don’t hesitate to reach out to Amazing Auctane-PL and our Instagram

jobs.title: MES Integration Engineer (M/F/NB)
jobs.description:
W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma sens tylko wtedy, gdy realnie wspiera ludzi i procesy biznesowe. Wspieramy naszych klientów w tworzeniu i rozwoju systemów IT oraz rozwiązań przemysłowych, które pomagają efektywniej zarządzać produkcją, danymi i procesami operacyjnymi.

Nasz dział Industrial Platform Solutions rozwija kompetencje związane z cyfryzacją przemysłu i systemami Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES). Tworzymy rozwiązania łączące świat IT z automatyką przemysłową, wspierając zakłady produkcyjne w obszarze integracji systemów, analizy danych procesowych i nowoczesnej produkcji cyfrowej.

Pracujemy blisko biznesu i rzeczywistych procesów produkcyjnych. Stawiamy na partnerską współpracę, prostotę rozwiązań i odpowiedzialność za dostarczane systemy.

O zespole i projektach

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego i wdrażającego rozwiązania MES oparte o technologie AVEVA (Wonderware), m.in. Platformę Systemową, Model-Driven MES, Historian oraz rozwiązania integracyjne.

Realizujemy międzynarodowe projekty dla dużych firm produkcyjnych z branży spożywczej, chemicznej i przemysłowej. Obecnie prowadzimy rollouty systemów MES w zakładach na kilku kontynentach, rozwijając rozwiązania po zakończonym wdrożeniu pilotażowym.

Pracujemy projektowo – w zależności od etapu wdrożenia możesz uczestniczyć zarówno w rozwoju nowych funkcjonalności, integracji systemów, rolloutach, upgrade’ach, jak i uruchomieniach produkcyjnych.

To rola dla osoby, która dobrze odnajduje się na styku IT, systemów przemysłowych i integracji. Szukamy inżyniera, który rozumie środowisko produkcyjne, potrafi pracować z danymi i systemami MES oraz swobodnie porusza się w technicznych aspektach wdrożeń.

Pracujemy w pełni zdalnie, z możliwością korzystania z biur we Wrocławiu, Katowicach, Poznaniu i Gdańsku.

Dlaczego warto?

To rola, w której:

pracujesz przy rzeczywistych wdrożeniach MES w dużych zakładach produkcyjnych
uczestniczysz w międzynarodowych projektach związanych z cyfryzacją produkcji
rozwijasz kompetencje na styku IT, OT i systemów przemysłowych
masz kontakt z nowoczesnym środowiskiem AVEVA i rozwiązaniami klasy MES
pracujesz w projektach obejmujących różne etapy wdrożeń – od integracji po rollout i uruchomienie
zdobywasz doświadczenie w środowisku produkcyjnym o dużej skali i złożoności
współpracujesz z doświadczonymi specjalistami z obszaru MES, automatyki i integracji przemysłowych
masz możliwość rozwoju w kierunku architektury rozwiązań przemysłowych i cyfryzacji produkcji

Jeśli interesuje Cię praca blisko rzeczywistych procesów produkcyjnych i chcesz rozwijać się w obszarze systemów MES oraz integracji przemysłowych – ta rola będzie dobrym wyborem.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój, konfigurację i wdrażanie systemów MES opartych o technologie AVEVA
integrację systemów produkcyjnych z bazami danych, systemami SCADA, ERP i innymi źródłami danych
pracę z danymi procesowymi oraz rozwój logiki biznesowej systemów MES
rozwój i utrzymanie komponentów aplikacyjnych z wykorzystaniem technologii webowych i backendowych
tworzenie oraz rozwój zapytań i logiki w Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL)
udział w rolloutach, uruchomieniach i działaniach wdrożeniowych w środowiskach produkcyjnych
współpracę z klientami przy analizie wymagań i rozwoju rozwiązań
wsparcie techniczne oraz troubleshooting systemów produkcyjnych
współpracę z zespołami projektowymi, automatykami i inżynierami po stronie klienta
udział w rozwoju standardów i najlepszych praktyk w obszarze MES i integracji przemysłowych

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz doświadczenie w pracy z systemami MES, SCADA
pracowałeś/aś z technologiami AVEVA / Wonderware lub podobnymi platformami przemysłowymi
dobrze rozumiesz integrację systemów IT/OT oraz środowiska produkcyjne
masz praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy z Microsoft SQL Server i T-SQL
potrafisz analizować i rozwiązywać problemy techniczne w złożonych środowiskach systemowych
znasz podstawy programowania i swobodnie poruszasz się w technologiach takich jak C#, JavaScript, SQL lub REST API
masz doświadczenie we wdrożeniach, rolloutach lub uruchomieniach systemów
potrafisz pracować zespołowo i komunikować się z klientem technicznym oraz biznesowym
komunikujesz się swobodnie w języku angielskim

Docenimy również:

znajomość AVEVA System Platform, Historian, MES, Batch lub Work Tasks
doświadczenie z integracją systemów przemysłowych
znajomość standardów ISA-95, ISA-88 lub PackML
doświadczenie z Git oraz procesami release/deployment
doświadczenie w migracjach lub upgrade’ach systemów
znajomość technologii frontendowych, np. Angular
doświadczenie z PLC/HMI/SCADA (Siemens, ABB, Beckhoff lub inne)
doświadczenie w branży spożywczej, farmaceutycznej lub chemicznej

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

rozwój poprzez pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku i różnorodnych projektach przemysłowych
możliwość zdobywania doświadczenia w nowoczesnych rozwiązaniach MES i cyfryzacji produkcji
współpracę z doświadczonym zespołem specjalistów MES, automatyki i integracji
budżet szkoleniowy i indywidualną ścieżkę rozwoju
benefity, takie jak prywatna opieka medyczna Medicover, karta Multisport, grupowe ubezpieczenie na życie czy dofinansowanie do posiłków
elastyczność w zakresie godzin pracy i modelu współpracy
możliwość korzystania z biur we Wrocławiu, Katowicach, Poznaniu i Gdańsku
udział w inicjatywach technologicznych, wydarzeniach wewnętrznych i społecznościach tematycznych

Jak przebiega proces rekrutacyjny?

Wyślij nam swoje CV – najlepiej w języku angielskim. W formularzu daj nam znać, jakie masz oczekiwania finansowe, preferowaną formę współpracy oraz od kiedy możesz rozpocząć pracę.
Sprawdzimy Twoją aplikację – przyjrzymy się Twojemu doświadczeniu w obszarze systemów MES, integracji i środowisk przemysłowych.
Rozmowa z HR (online) – partnerska rozmowa o Twoim doświadczeniu, projektach i oczekiwaniach.
Rozmowa techniczna (online) – spotkanie z osobami z zespołu projektowego, podczas którego porozmawiamy o Twoim doświadczeniu z systemami MES, SQL, integracjami i projektami wdrożeniowymi.
Feedback – po zakończeniu procesu wrócimy do Ciebie z informacją zwrotną.

Możesz też zajrzeć na naszą stronę internetową lub Facebooka i zobaczyć, co ciekawego się u nas dzieje!

Nasza firma wdrożyła procedury ochrony sygnalistów zgodnie z obowiązującą ustawą. Każda osoba ma prawo zgłaszać nieprawidłowości w bezpieczny sposób, a zgłoszenia są objęte pełną ochroną prawną. Więcej informacji: https://www.etteplan.com/pl/kodeks-postepowania/

Role Overview

We’re seeking a skilled and proactive Full Stack Developer with deep expertise in Angular, .NET, and SQL to join our dynamic engineering team. You’ll design, develop, and maintain end-to-end features for our enterprise-grade applications, from intuitive front-end interfaces to high-performance back-end services and databases.

The ideal candidate thrives on autonomy, actively researches emerging frameworks and tools, and isn’t afraid to experiment with novel solutions to optimize our stack. Experience with AI tools or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems is a strong plus!

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain responsive, high-performance web applications using Angular (v18+) for the front end.

Build scalable, secure APIs and services using .NET Core/.NET 6+ (C#).

Design, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and database schemas (SQL Server/PostgreSQL preferred).

Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate requirements into clean, efficient code.

Proactively research, evaluate, and integrate new libraries, frameworks, or tools to solve technical challenges.

Write unit/integration tests, participate in code reviews, and uphold best practices for security and performance.

Bonus: Leverage AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, LLM APIs) or implement RAG systems to enhance application intelligence, search, or automation.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field from a local university in Singapore

3+ years of professional experience in full stack development.

Front End: Expertise in Angular 18+ (RxJS, NgRx, TypeScript, Angular CLI).

Back End: Strong proficiency in .NET Core/.NET 6+, RESTful APIs, Entity Framework, and dependency injection.

Database: Advanced SQL skills (query optimization, indexing, transaction management) with experience in relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL).

Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (Azure/AliCloud).

Excellent problem solving and analytical skills

Strong communication (English, Chinese) and teamwork skills

Self-driven learner who independently explores and adopts new technologies to improve solutions.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have)

Experience with AI/ML tools (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector databases like Pinecone/Qdrant).

Hands-on work with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures or LLM integration.

United by purpose, we bring our best selves to work every day, embracing a high-performance, player-learner culture that inspires collaboration, curiosity, and ambition. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take charge of your own career, harnessing your skills, passion, and enthusiasm for learning to continually grow and progress. Together, we’re not just shaping brighter smiles, we’re unlocking the potential of people everywhere, including our own.

Intro

As Director, Global Software Development – Straumann Digital Platform, you will lead the development and delivery of a strategic technology platform at the heart of Straumann’s digital dentistry ecosystem.

You will oversee a distributed software engineering organization and help shape how our teams build, deliver, and operate scalable cloud services, connected workflows, AI-enabled capabilities, integrations, and data-driven products.

Working closely with Product Management, Architecture, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Operations, and other business partners, you will combine technology leadership with delivery execution and people development. A key part of the role will be helping growing engineering teams establish clear structures, effective practices, and the capabilities they need to succeed at scale.Your Role

You Will

Lead the end-to-end develo/pment and delivery of the Straumann Digital Platform, translating strategy into roadmaps, technical milestones, and measurable outcomes.
Lead and develop distributed engineering teams, creating clear accountability, effective ways of working, and strong collaboration across locations and functions.
Partner with architecture leaders to evolve a secure, modular, scalable, and maintainable platform architecture.
Strengthen engineering practices across cloud development, DevOps, continuous integration and delivery, test automation, observability, API-based integration, and secure-by-design development.
Balance near-term product priorities with long-term platform sustainability, including the active management of technical debt.
Embed quality, cybersecurity, privacy, and regulatory requirements into everyday engineering practices, including relevant medical-device software standards.
Improve delivery predictability, platform reliability, engineering productivity, and operational maturity through meaningful metrics and feedback loops.
Develop engineering managers, technical leaders, and emerging talent while helping build the capabilities required for future growth.
Champion responsible adoption of automation, AI-assisted development, and modern engineering tools.
Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and investment needs clearly to senior stakeholders.

Essential

Your Profile:

Significant experience leading distributed software engineering teams or organizations in a complex environment.
Strong experience with software platforms, cloud-based architectures, enterprise software, or connected digital ecosystems.
Experience working in a regulated or quality-critical environment such as medical devices, healthcare, automotive, aerospace, or financial services.
Practical understanding of modern software engineering approaches, including DevOps, CI/CD, test automation, cybersecurity, cloud operations, and API-based integration.
Experience improving software delivery, quality, collaboration, and engineering effectiveness.
A track record of developing teams, leaders, engineering practices, and organizational capabilities.
Ability to communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical senior stakeholders.
Strong business perspective, with the ability to connect technology investments to customer value, scalability, quality, compliance, and lifecycle considerations.

Nice to Have

Experience with medical-device software standards such as IEC 62304 or quality systems aligned with ISO 13485.
Experience scaling platform engineering capabilities, AI-enabled development practices, or global software operating models.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You create clarity when priorities, technologies, and stakeholder needs are complex. You give teams appropriate ownership while establishing clear expectations and accountability.

You are motivated by developing people and helping growing engineering organizations mature. You make decisions transparently, use evidence to guide priorities, and are comfortable balancing delivery speed with quality, security, compliance, and long-term technical sustainability.

You collaborate effectively across functions, cultures, and locations and build trust through clear communication, thoughtful decision-making, and consistent follow-through.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

jobs.title: CE - System Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

System Engineer is responsible for servicing customers, both onsite & remotely. Including implementation, customization, integration, support, optimization of Information Management and Digital Transformation, and troubleshooting Canon related applications, such as Printing & Document Management Systems. The role focuses on document capture, intelligent document processing (OCR/AI), enterprise content management, document archiving, workflow automation, digital signatures, print management, and integration with business applications. The engineer will work closely with customers during pre-sales, project implementation, training, and post-sales support to ensure successful solution deployment and customer satisfaction.

The position plays a key role in expanding Canon's professional services capabilities and supporting the growth of software and recurring services revenue.

Responsibilities

Presales Support

Validate proposed solutions against customer requirements, Statement of Work (SOW), licensing requirements, hardware specifications and implementation effort.
Conduct technical discovery workshops and infrastructure assessments.
Analyze customer business processes, document workflows and print environments to recommend suitable solutions.
Identify implementation risks, technical dependencies and integration requirements.
Support sales teams during solution presentations, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts and customer workshops.
Provide technical consultation on Canon's software and solutions portfolio.
Assist in sizing, scoping and solution architecture design.
Recommend best practices for print management, document workflows and information governance.

Print Management Solutions

Install, configure and implement print management solutions such as uniFLOW, uniFLOW Online, PaperCut and related applications.
Configure secure printing, pull printing, Follow-Me Printing, mobile printing and guest printing solutions.
Configure authentication mechanisms including Active Directory, Azure AD, PIN, card readers and Single Sign-On (SSO).
Implement cost recovery, departmental charging, quota management and print accounting solutions.
Deploy secure scan-to-email, scan-to-folder and scan workflow solutions.
Configure reporting, auditing and compliance features.
Integrate print management solutions with multifunction devices and customer systems.
Conduct print fleet optimization assessments and deployment activities.

Information Management Solutions

Install, configure and support document management and enterprise content management solutions.
Configure document capture, scanning, OCR and Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) platforms.
Design and implement workflow automation and digital transformation solutions.
Develop indexing structures, metadata schemas and document retention policies.
Configure digital archiving repositories and information governance controls.
Implement electronic and digital signature solutions.
Configure forms, templates and validation workflows.
Integrate solutions with ERP, HRMS, CRM and other business applications.
Configure APIs, web services and data exchange mechanisms.
Develop custom reports, templates and business process workflows.
Perform data migration, system upgrades and solution enhancements where required.

Project Delivery & Customer Engagement

Conduct detailed requirements gathering workshops where necessary.
Ensure all project deliverables are completed according to agreed scope and timelines.
Document all customizations, integrations and configurations.
Conduct system testing and user acceptance testing (UAT).
Demonstrate completed solutions and obtain customer sign-off.
Deliver administrator and end-user training.
Provide go-live support and transition projects into support management.

Service Support Management

Provide remote and onsite solutions support to Canon customers in the three countries in which we operate directly as and when needed.
Escalate complex issues to the specialist in the regional office or via 3rd level support and be accountable until the issue is fully resolved.
Update documentation (changes, modifications, configurations, incidents for the solutions that are implemented during the post-sales stage.
Provide technical assistance and support to the field service engineers when needed.
Ensure adherence to SLA commitments and customer service standards.
Troubleshoot issues related to printing, scanning, OCR, workflows, authentication and integrations.
Perform health checks, preventive maintenance and solution optimization activities.
Monitor system performance and recommend improvements.

General/Specifics

Take overall functional and technical responsibility for assigned Solutions implementation and commissioning.
Attend training courses on nominated solutions as required.
Deliver effective training sessions for nominated Solutions to his field engineers’ colleagues when necessary.
Coordinate with Service Teams to Increase the Connectivity ratio of Canon Devices to e-Maintenance
Maintain knowledge of emerging technologies, industry trends and Canon software solutions.
Attend vendor certification and product training programs.
Share knowledge and conduct internal training sessions for colleagues.
Support initiatives that increase software adoption and recurring services revenue.
Promote Canon's professional image through excellent customer engagement and technical expertise.

Qualifications

Must have/be:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field (or the equivalent) 
5 or more years of experience in related IT position (consulting experience a plus)
Demonstrates proficiency in a variety of hardware & software & expertise in a variety of the IT industry’s concepts, practices & procedures
Experience implementing and supporting enterprise software solutions in customer environments.
Strong understanding of Microsoft Windows Server environments (2016/2019/2022 and later).
Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, LDAP and authentication services.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking, SMTP, SSL/TLS, SNMP and network troubleshooting.
Experience with Microsoft SQL Server installation, administration, backup and troubleshooting.
Experience with virtualization technologies such as VMware and Hyper-V.
Experience with Microsoft 365 and cloud-related technologies.
Experience implementing Print Management Solutions.
Experience implementing Document Management or Enterprise Content Management Solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong customer-facing communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Valid GCC driving license.

Preferred Technical Experience

Print Management Solutions

uniFLOW
uniFLOW Online

Scripting & Integration Skills

Experience with PowerShell scripting.
Knowledge of Python, JavaScript or similar scripting languages.
Experience working with REST APIs and Web Services.
Understanding of JSON, XML and system integrations.
Ability to troubleshoot logs, services and application integrations.
Familiarity with database queries and SQL reporting.

AI & Intelligent Automation

Exposure to Artificial Intelligence technologies within Information Management environments.
Experience with Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), document classification and automated data extraction solutions is an advantage.
Understanding of AI-driven workflow automation and document understanding technologies.

Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer or equivalent.
